method: read-only SSH source inspection and exact source-copy hashes; no translator/build invocation

facts_from_source.main_flag: CliOpts.monomorphize is a bool with #[clap(long, visible_alias = "mono")]; the CLI spelling is --monomorphize with alias --mono. The doc says generic items found in the crate are skipped; --start-from selects a particular call graph; dyn Trait is not currently supported.
facts_from_source.separate_mutability_flag: monomorphize_mut is a distinct optional-valued flag using require_equals=true and default_missing_value("all"). Validation rejects ExceptTypes unless remove_adt_clauses is true.
facts_from_source.aeneas_preset: Preset::Aeneas adds associated-type lifting and several normalization/visibility options; it does not set monomorphize and does not set duplicate_defaulted_methods.
facts_from_source.compatibility: CliOpts::validate has no condition/conflict check for monomorphize with Preset::Aeneas. The option is declared independently; code inspection finds no incompatibility rejection. No actual CLI parse/translation was run.
facts_from_source.preset_application: driver calls options.apply_preset() for the selected crate before building TranslateOptions.
facts_from_source.mapping: CliOpts.monomorphize maps to TranslateOptions.monomorphize_with_hax; TranslateCtx::monomorphize() tests whether the current item source is Mono or MonoTrait.
facts_from_source.defaulted_methods: Trait declaration translation has a mono-mode early return with a TODO saying default methods/default consts are not supported there. Trait impl translation also returns early in mono mode. In its separate non-early-return branch, an impl item with no explicit body can reuse the trait declaration default. duplicate_defaulted_methods is a separate transformation option; the Aeneas preset does not turn it on.
